method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: The panorama at the crossing was resected on the west end of the Norra Långgatan front and on the fold of the canted corner; the district outline's three corner points do not fit one camera within 20 px, so the corner's two short faces are kept as drawn and only the long fronts carry measured windows. The Proviantgatan panorama stands about 4.3 m from that front and was resected on its north corner and on the joint with the white house to the south; its base row agrees with a camera 2.3 m high. The two fronts' floor heights differ by up to 0.2 m (the street slopes); the Proviantgatan values are used for both. The roof is barely seen and is an estimate.
